_status: APPROVED brand, 12 Nov 2026. Source of truth: John's Chiron Leadership design system (https://claude.ai/artifact/WLgTtjTTT6Lrqj7JhBWCiS: README, tokens.json, logo files). This file maps it onto the class library's token names (navy = brand navy, pitch = action colour on light = navy, brass = gold-light on navy, brass-deep = small gold text on light, gold = graphics/large text on light). Fonts: Cinzel 600 (display: headings, wordmark), Inter 400/600 (body, buttons, labels), Cormorant Garamond 500 italic (tagline and quotes only). Layout: square corners by default, buttons radius 2px, all-caps buttons with 0.08em tracking.

_roles.color-line: hairlines and borders on light backgrounds
_roles.color-navy: main dark brand colour: headings, dark sections
_roles.color-pitch: action colour on light backgrounds: buttons, links, check marks (navy in the Chiron palette)
_roles.color-pitch-soft: parchment: alternate sections, booking band, hover tint
_roles.color-brass: accent: eyebrows on dark, icons, markers
_roles.color-brass-deep: accent dark enough for small text on light backgrounds
_roles.color-gold: gold for rules, icons and large text on light backgrounds (not small text: 3.1:1)

font-serif._role: display: headings and the wordmark, weight 600, Title Case, 0.04em tracking (label kept as font-serif for the class library)

font-accent._role: tagline and client quotes only, 500 italic
